Scope: supplemental draft for separate researcher-reviewed BOI optical descriptions; does not replace production dictionary 0.3.0-draft
AggregationRule: No cohort aggregation or derived amplitude-area-duration composite in this increment.

Measurements.Name: Reviewed signed optical extrema
Measurements.Question: What signed changes occur within the reviewed interval relative to its accepted reference?
Measurements.Formula: q=(r(a:b)-B)/B; minimum=min(q); maximum=max(q); percent=100*fraction; retain all tied extremum frames
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Preserved-input mean on original fixed native union; B=mean of exactly the researcher-accepted pre-onset frames. Corrected trace supports review, not the denominator.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Source-bound reference and reviewed inclusive event interval; external 1 Hz frame clock. Reference count is explicit, including 12 samples at 165–176. Native overlaps remain context.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: No accepted reference for the onset, invalid reference mean or nonfinite samples withholds dependent quantities. Preserve all alternatives and uncertain recognition.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Local exploratory optical result, not oxygen concentration/deficit or independent physiological validation. No cohort pooling or native-mask changes.
Measurements.Implementation: not yet implemented; proposed separate reviewed optical helper/export
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: proposed; no new recording quantity calculated
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: B=100, event=[100,80,100] gives signed minimum -0.2 and maximum 0.

Measurements.Name: Reviewed amplitude under the saved sign convention

Measurements.Name: Reviewed interval duration
Measurements.Question: How many modeled frame intervals belong to the saved reviewed bounds?
Measurements.Formula: duration=(b-a+1)/fs; endpoint span=(b-a)/fs; keep both explicitly named
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Saved reviewed frame boundaries; reference is not required for duration.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Source-bound reference and reviewed inclusive event interval; external 1 Hz frame clock. Reference count is explicit, including 12 samples at 165–176. Native overlaps remain context.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Missing/invalid boundaries withhold duration; absent optical reference does not erase valid timing. Preserve discrete alternatives.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Local exploratory optical result, not oxygen concentration/deficit or independent physiological validation. No cohort pooling or native-mask changes.
Measurements.Implementation: not yet implemented; proposed separate reviewed optical helper/export
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: proposed; no new recording quantity calculated
Measurements.WorkedExample: Teaching only: frames 10–12 at 1 Hz give duration 3 s and endpoint span 2 s; neither defines camera exposure.
